notes.title: Hotfix: Achievements and Save Files
notes.notes:
Hi, us again.

Updating the build based on some feedback (thank you for letting us know!) that:
[olist]
  Achievements weren't unlocking. It's fixed now, though it won't retroactively reward the achievements.
 Save files were not appearing correctly.  Cloud settings have been updated, please try the following and get in touch with support@NeverAloneGame.com if things still aren't working out and you need a hand.  Here are the steps:
[/olist]
To retrieve and enable your old save files, please do the following:
[olist]
 Navigate to the following folder by copy and pasting this path in windows explorer:
%UserProfile%/AppData/LocalLow/E_Line Media/Never Alone
 Copy the "cprofile.dat" file found there.
 Then and paste it in the folder located here:
%UserProfile%/AppData/LocalLow/E-Line Media/Never Alone
[/olist]

notes.title: Linux version available and Happy Holidays
notes.notes:
Never Alone is now officially released for Linux - If you currently already have Never Alone in your Steam Library, you'll automatically have access on a Linux (+SteamOS) platform now! And if you don't have it yet, you should check out the great deals going on now in the Steam Winter Sale: 75% off!

You can find more details andf requirements for Linux here.

Happy Holidays from the Never Alone team!

notes.title: Mac Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
http://neveralonegame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/MacVersion_1920_1080_Updated.jpg

Since the initial launch of Never Alone back in November, the most common questions we've heard from fans are about a version for Mac users.  Well, for weeks now, we've been hard at work making sure that the Mac version is up to the same level of excellence as its PC, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4 counterparts.  And we're happy to announce that the wait is over: the Steam version of Never Alone is now available for Mac!

If you've purchased Never Alone on Steam in the past, you now automatically have the Mac version.  If you've been waiting to experience the journey of Nuna and Fox until the Mac version's release, welcome!  The team at Upper One Games and E-Line Media are thrilled that you're finally able to play the game.

Enjoy!

-The Never Alone Team
support@neveralonegame.com

notes.title: Mac Version Coming in Early 2015
notes.notes:
http://neveralonegame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Nuna_fox.jpg

Unnusatkun!  (Good evening!)

A few weeks ago we launched Never Alone on PC, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4 and have been humbled by the warm reception to the game in these cold autumn months.  We are very excited to reach such a diverse audience around the world and have been inspired by your feedback and suggestions.

One simple but very common question we've been asked over the last few weeks is: will there be a Mac version?

We're thrilled to announce that the answer is yes!  Never Alone will be available via Steam on the Mac in early 2015.  We can't wait to share the story of Nuna and Fox with an even wider audience.  Stay tuned to our Steam page, follow us on Twitter at @neveralonegame, or like our Facebook page for a release date!

Katigatchiarit, Mac users.  (Pleased to meet you.)

The Never Alone Team
support@neveralonegame.com

notes.title: Never Alone v1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Halauġikpiñ! (Hello!)

What an incredible week it's been!   The positive response to Never Alone has been overwhelming, inspiring and humbling to all of us at E-Line / Upper One Games.  We've tried to read every review of the game, watch every Twitch stream, and listen to all the public commentary to really understand the experiences that players are having.   It's been wonderful watching all the great streaming and video playthroughs from around the world!

Launching the game is just the beginning, though.

We're working hard on improvements to Never Alone that will be available over the next few weeks, as we release regular patches and updates.  We're excited to be able to share the first patch for the PC/Steam version today to address some issues we have been hearing about, and will also get those improvements out to the Xbox One and Playstation 4 versions very soon.

Tonight’s patch (v1.1) contains the following improvements:

In single-player mode, the character you're not controlling will behave more intelligently
The difficulty of the last few chapters of the game is more balanced with earlier chapters
General control improvements
It will be harder to accidentally switch to co-op mode when using the keyboard
Fixes to address Save Game issues
Fixed a bug where Never Alone would fail to launch when Steam was in Offline Mode


In addition, this patch includes a new key-binding text file that is optimized for play on AZERTY and DVORAK keyboards. You can find instructions on the support page

Please refer to the Patch Notes for additional details and instructions:

Patch Notes FAQ Link

Stay tuned in the coming weeks for additional content updates! 

Thank you to everyone for your continued support of Never Alone.  It means a lot to the entire team and the Alaska Native Community. 

The Never Alone Team
support@neveralonegame.com
